command: llvm-mc -triple=aarch64 -filetype=obj A64-P1-add-register.s -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: Input: `add x0, x1, x2` / `add x5, x6, x7` / `add x0, x1, xzr`. The third pair fixes register number 31 in Rm, which is XZR in this form; it is the widest value the 5-bit field holds, not a register-class check. Recovered 2026-11-09: the input was not stored; it was rebuilt from the spellings recorded in this note, kept at `research/evidence/experiments/EXP-0008/A64-P1-add-register.s` and `input_sha256` re-pinned to those bytes. The recorded command still emits the committed 12-byte image.
